AbstractFacet phrase discovery is a textual information processing task concerned with the automatic identification of representative phrases in multilingual documents that capture salient topics for semantic indexing, search, clustering, and classification. This article surveys the problem space, reviews supervised and unsupervised approaches, compares evaluation protocols, and discusses open challenges in cross-lingual and domain-adaptive settings. This article is categorized under:
Ensemble Methods > Web Mining
Ensemble Methods > Text Mining
result.title: A survey of facet phrase discovery in multilingual documents
